prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence remains thin for most change types, as only adoption new_flow, choose_path copy, finish new_screen, home new_flow, and sign_in hint have been tested at least twice.
choose_path copy and finish new_screen changes consistently showed no clear effect across all completed tests.
home new_flow and sign_in hint are helpful change types that delivered wins, though some tests showed no clear effect.
adoption new_flow can be helpful, but most tests (3 out of 4) showed no clear effect.
Predictions were generally too high overall, but consistently underestimated results for home new_flow.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_flow: +0.1% after noise correction, 4 test(s)
- choose_path, copy: -0.4% after noise correction, 3 test(s)
- choose_path, layout: +1.8% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, hint: -1.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, layout: -0.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_screen: +0.7% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- home, new_flow: +3.0% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- home, redesign: +1.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, wait_info: -0.3% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, hint: +1.9% after noise correction, 3 test(s)
- sign_in, incentive: -2.9% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: -1.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

- sign_in: 76.0%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 63.3%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 87.9%, median 201s / mean 2336s

Changes:
0: [sign_in, hint] Existing Account Pet Recovery Callout: Add a clear account sync hint on the sign-in screen informing users that signing into their existing account restores previously created pets. (why: Support received 8 emails about pets missing or reset after signing in again, and sign_in hints have proven to be an effective change type.)
1: [adoption, redesign] Split Layout Customization Workspace: Redesign the companion pick screen into a split workspace layout separating companion selection choices from live pet preview components. (why: Adoption step drops to 63.3% conversion, and 3 support emails reported custom pet generation failures or unexpected visuals.)
2: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Companion Interaction Onboarding Screen: Insert a dedicated onboarding screen prior to completion that demonstrates basic desktop pet controls, hiding shortcuts, and interaction commands. (why: Multiple support emails noted post-onboarding confusion regarding how to control, hide, or converse with their desktop pet.)
3: [sign_in, reorder] Post-Adoption Sign-In Journey Reorder: Move sign-in after pet adoption and customization screens so users establish emotional investment before account setup. (why: Moving account sign-in after pet selection leverages high adoption intent to reduce onboarding churn.)
4: [choose_path, layout] Spotlight Companion Path Selector: Update the path selection screen to a spotlight layout focusing attention on one companion onboarding journey at a time. (why: Choose path mean duration is 514s despite an 8s median, indicating some users experience choice paralysis.)
5: [adoption, copy] Clear Photo Upload Requirement Instructions: Provide clear copy on photo upload guidelines explaining lighting and framing for accurate pet model generation. (why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet generation failing or yielding distorted pet visual results.)
6: [home, notification] Background Pet Spawn Ready Desktop Alert: Enable desktop readiness notifications on the waiting screen so users can minimize the app while pet generation completes. (why: The generation phase takes hundreds of seconds, and 3 users filed tickets when pets failed to show up on screen immediately.)

scores.note: High support volume (8 emails) and sign_in hints are proven effective (+1.9%). Quick copy update.
Adoption has high dropoff (36.7%), but redesigns require high effort with uncertain historical lift.
Finish step has high loss, but finish new_screen consistently showed no clear effect across tests.
Previous sign_in reorder test resulted in negative lift (-1.4%), lacks support mail backing.
High mean time indicates confusion, and layout change showed +1.8% in single test.
Targets largest dropoff step (adoption) backed by 3 support tickets, low implementation cost.
Home step has lower total dropoff, but long wait times and support tickets justify notification alert.
